name: nodelane-act
description: Use Reddit, Zhihu, X and WhatsApp through your signed-in browser with compact, on-demand MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Reddit, Zhihu, X and WhatsApp in your browser
interface.longDescription: Read feeds, search discussions, check notifications, manage chats and publish through your signed-in browser. Discover only the operations needed for your task and receive compact results. Requires Node.js 22+ and the companion browser extension on the same computer.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recommendations from my signed-in Zhihu browser tab.
Find relevant Reddit discussions and summarize the top comments.
Summarize my X home feed and unread notification counts.
